messages:
Rohan (People Ops): Dropping a single manager+HR checklist thread for Priya's new hire (Riley) starting Wed. Keep replies short so IT can act tonight.

Pre-day items (today):
- Confirm legal name + display name (Priya).
- Upload ID & emergency contact to HR portal (Riley).
- Device: Eli to confirm model & courier vs pickup.
- Add Riley to #product, #pm, #new-hires, and docs groups.
- OnboardBot checklist created and assign Maggie as buddy.

Day 1 (low bandwidth):
- 09:30: HR intro (benefits + payroll)  20m (Rohan).
- 11:00: Team intros (15m)  no slides.
- 13:00: Product tour + metrics walkthrough (Maggie).
- 15:00: 1:1 with Priya (30m) to set expectations & top 3 priorities.
- Micro task: pick one customer story and write a 1-page summary with 2 suggested actions.

Week 1 outcomes:
- Complete SSO, MFA, and mandatory trainings.
- Shadow one customer call and one sprint planning.
- Share a 1-page "first impressions" in #product.

30/60/90 bullets (paste into 1:1):
- 30d: Understand core users, complete onboarding tasks, own a small spec.
- 60d: Run an experiment and measure impact; iterate.
- 90d: Deliver a measurable improvement tied to metrics and propose next steps.

Logistics & links:
- HR portal: https://hr.redwood.local/onboard (Rohan).
- Badge pickup / courier: security desk (Eli).
- Console access form: /forms/console-access (Priya include GitHub handle).

Priya (Hiring Manager): I'll send the welcome email now and include GitHub handle. Maggie confirmed buddy slot at 13:00. Please add a day-3 check-in to the checklist.

Rohan (People Ops): Done  OnboardBot checklist OB-2203334444 created and reminders at day-3 and day-7. Link: https://onboard.redwood.local/checklist/OB-2203334444

Eli (IT): Laptop imaged (14\" MBP). Pickup 09:30 or courier option available. Need phone for MFA or we can issue a hardware key. Also need GitHub username for team sync.

Maggie (Buddy): I'll prepare a short template for the 1-page summary and run the product tour (dashboard + backlog + one support ticket).

Riley (new hire): Thanks team! Quick Q: preferred format for the 1-page?

Maggie (Buddy): Bullets + 3 suggested next steps works. Drop in #product and attach to OnboardBot checklist.

OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: security training due in 72 hours; HR forms due in 5 days. Checklist link: https://onboard.redwood.local/checklist/OB-2203334444

Rohan (People Ops): Closing pre-day items unless blockers. Reply here if something changes overnight. :thumbsup:
